### Detection Details:
The incident was classified as a Critical severity Privacy Spill, detected via an Abnormal DNS Beacon and CloudTrail logs. The alert is associated with the host 'test123'. The summary notes are placeholder text, indicating a lack of detailed investigative findings.

### Incident Timeline:
- **(2025-10-14 17:05:32 UTC)** — Initial detection of the incident.

### Triage:
- **Host:** test123
- **Source Name:** Pads (pads-9fc38)
- **User Info:** swimlane_system (System User)
- **Case URL:** [Case Link](https://swimlane.assets.afasdemo.com:443/account/f3349d75-6783-4a74-9c3c-76f396e19e9a/tenant/679bd671-c2de-4d6d-b1f0-91f0d65406ce/record/aEza_JJOovvdR3rIX/aRJymN3UfJM7SMEnM)

### Actions Taken:
- **Requested User Information:** An inquiry was made to gather details about the user associated with the affected host to assess their role and potential level of compromise.
- **Quarantined File:** A suspicious or malicious file, presumably the source of the DNS beaconing, was isolated on the host to prevent further execution and lateral movement.
- **Reset User Credentials:** The password for the user account associated with the host was reset as a precaution to invalidate any credentials that may have been stolen by an attacker.
